encouragementMessage: Don't hesitate to reach out! Student hours are YOUR time. Whether you're stuck on an assignment, want a second opinion on something a tool told you, or just want to talk through where the course is going, I'm here to help. Students who use student hours consistently do better in the course. If none of the posted times work with your job or childcare, email me and we'll find a time that does.
